exposure: Number of children in a family
Mothers who ceased EBF before six months (n=208)
cohort: 338 mother-child pairs in rural Jaffna, Sri Lanka
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding up to six months was low, and early cessation was associated with maternal employment, low birth weight, and Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section birth was associated with early discontinuation of exclusive breastfeeding.
